notes.title: Hotfix after 1.0!
notes.notes:
Oof! There were more bugs that snuck into the 1.0 launch than we’d like to admit! These bugs snuck past our testing because they’re all related to optimizations we needed to make for Fling’s console launch (which is coming soon).

They’re fixed now! Thank you all for being patient and making us aware of these bugs on the Steam forums and on our Discord server.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the major bug where no more than 3 players could join an online lobby.
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes objects like trees and worms would be invisible.
[*] Fixed the bug where the Bomb Run timer would freeze.
[*] Fixed the bug where the large elevator in Winding Woods would not spawn after pulling the lever.
[*] Fixed the bug where the falling pinball bumpers in Pinball Panic were missing
[*] Fixed the bug where unlocks were not properly showing in the main menu.
[*] Fixed the bug where usernames wouldn’t show in the main menu.
[*] Fixed the bug where player levels weren’t synced up correctly.
[*] Fixed issue where a few of the new characters were displaying incorrectly. 
[/list]

notes.title: Online Bug Fix in Tutorial Level
notes.notes:
Heyho Flingers,

A quick fix is live! It’s a fix related to our online servers so you do not need to update your game in order to benefit from the fix.

The bug was preventing some players from finishing the tutorial in online multiplayer. This would only happen if the host of the online session was in the European region or Eastern Russia region but it’s possible some other regions were being affected as well. 

Specifically, in the Tutorial, the UFO platforms that you stick to to progress to the next section would not show up for the computer that isn't the host of the session. Sometimes the UFO platforms would appear but not move when being stuck to. And sometimes obstacles in other levels such as the Laser UFOs at the end of Kooky’s Canyons would not be synced properly online. These have all been fixed. 

Please let us know if you experience any bugs. You could reply to this post, post it on the community forum, or post it on our Discord. 

Hope you all keep having a fun and smooth experience! We’re excited to get you all our next update very soon!

notes.title: Halloween 2022 Patch
notes.notes:
Hey Flingers, quick patch here! 

We fixed a bug where the Witches' Brooms weren't showing up in the spookified levels.  They're another catchup mechanic which allow teams who are falling behind to grab a ride and catch up to the first place team more quickly. They're also super fun and physics-based so we wanted to make sure they made it into this Spooky Season.

Have fun!
Team SplitSide

notes.title: Online Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey Flingers! With the new level out, we thought now would be a good time to crack down on all the current major bugs! A lot of players brought up online desync issues in Worms in Space and other levels which appear to get worse the longer you play. These issues are fixed! There are many other bug fixes, optimizations and improvements so feel free to check them out below.

[b]Quality of Life improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved the tutorial before the main menu to better explain all the different ways you can create a team online and locally.
[/list]
[b]Optimizations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the size of many textures in Perilous Paradise which were increasing the game’s download size unnecessarily.
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple cameras were rendering on top of each other during level cinematics. This will improve performance on medium and low end machines.
[*] Optimized all Water and Fog shaders which should improve performance on low end machines.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a major issue where the level loaded after Perilous Paradise would become unplayable online due to desync.
[*] Fixed a major issue where Worms in Space would become unplayable online due to desync.
[*] Fixed many levels which would sometimes become unplayable due to online desync (Pharaoh’s Freeway, Pete’s Play Palace, Haunted Highway, Winding Woods, Perilous Paradise).
[*] Fixed a major issue where returning to the team setup screen would break if a player left during the race.
[*] Removed many game breaking shortcuts in the Perilous Paradise level.
[*] Fixed issue where a series of random letters will appear over another player’s head instead of their Steam username.
[*] For new players, settings in the Online Tab will now start at their correct defaults (displaying names over other characters is now the default).
[*] In the Demo, the time left in the demo will be displayed in the main menu again (this was accidently removed during the original 3D Menu update).
[*] Your Username will no longer appear in your own friend’s list.
[/list]

Team Splitside & Daedalic Entertainment

notes.title: Holiday update: Christmas & Bowling!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We hope you’re bundled up with friends and family and ready for the Winter Season! This month you’ll be able to compete in our Holiday event, master our two new SHOCKING race abilities and play our brand new level: Loony Lanes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34767207/da74ff0cad20651c222396fca97d650d4f48fe3e.png[/img]

Loony Lanes has you sliding down bowling lanes of the 70s and 80s. You’ll have to transition from the slippery lanes lit by neon lights to the dark, treacherous, mechanical under-workings of the bowling alley operation. This level is fully featured with every game mode!

The core of the Holiday season will be a community competition between Team Jolly and Team Snowman. Choose a team, receive your team skins, and compete in Matchmaking races. Whichever team has the most wins at the end of the season will receive a special skin of their team mascot.

We’re so excited for you to play our Brand New Level and compete to be the victor of the Holiday Season!

Team SplitSide


Levels
- A brand new level: Loony Lanes

Race Abilities
- That’s Shocking! Electrify your opponents with a surge of static electricity that gives them a ZAP at the most inopportune times!
- Stick Pulse! Give yourself the power to send out a shockwave every time you stick! Use it to blast away your opponents or defend yourself from pestering obstacles!

Holiday Community Competition
Team Jolly
- 1 Character: Jolly Jingle
- 4 alternative skins

Team Snowman
- 1 Character: Snowman
- 4 alternative skins

General Game Patch Notes
Bugs
- The visuals showing you were your rope is when obscured by objects have returned
- The colors of your character’s stick goo is now properly synced across the internet
- A team that has the laser ability can no longer be cut by other lasers

notes.title: De-Spookify Patch
notes.notes:
The Fling Halloween Season has come to an end! 

Team Calavera raced valiantly but ultimately Team Jack-O-Lantern came out on top! When members of Team Jack-O-Lantern update to this latest version and start the game they will receive an exclusive skin. Enjoy!

Because the Halloween Season has come to end the levels are no longer spookified. But as a special surprise to mark the end of the season... there is a brand new level: Haunted Highway!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34767207/04dd63194d3f43a05ab8ca2ca4263db9446a3b62.png[/img]

Haunted Highway might be one of our best looking levels yet. Our goal for the level was for it be one of the easiest levels in the game while still providing a lot of challenging nuances when trying to race fast against the clock. That way it will help round out the difficulty curve at the beginning of the game while providing a great competitive track for race mode. We'll see you on the Haunted Highway!

Team SplitSide

notes.title: Difficulty Patch - Tweaks to Balancing and Accessibility
notes.notes:
With this patch, we’ve taken a closer look at ability balancing and accessibility, among other things.

We’ve made improvements to various levels in the game to make them less frustrating, as well as rebalancing how often the Balloon and Spring Jump abilities appear to make the game more fair while still keeping it fun for players in all positions of the race!

You will also require less ducks to progress through the Campaign mode, with Silver and Bronze Duck tiers having a higher time limit making the campaign mode more accessible, while retaining the satisfaction of getting a Gold Duck.

See the full changes below:

[i]Notes[/i]
Online Multiplayer can no longer be disabled in the Privacy Policy or Settings menu.

[i]Balancing[/i]
[olist]
[*] Made multiple level design improvements to Winding Woods, Worms in Space, Pharaoh’s Freeway, Fling Park, and Sunny Heights to make them more fun and less frustrating. 
[*] Reduced the amount of Ducks needed to unlock new levels in Campaign mode.
[*] Increased the time required to receive Silver and Bronze ducks in all the Campaign gamemodes.
[*] Decreased the likelihood the Balloon ability is given when a team is close to the first place team.
[*] Increased the likelihood the Spring Jump ability is given.
[/olist]

[i]Improvements[/i]
[olist]
[*] Mushroom bouncers now push the team in the air much more consistently.
[*] Teams now spawn into the race lined up in a row rather than clumped up in a ball.
[/olist]

[i]Bug Fixes[/i]
[olist]
[*] A player’s client is less likely to timeout and get stuck on the Matchmaking screen. If it still times out, then matchmaking will restart.
[*] Fixed a bug where players couldn’t leave the Matchmaking screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where some rows in the Leaderboard screen will be missing.
[*] Fixed a bug where teams can Fling an infinite amount of times in the air in some areas within some levels.
[/olist]

notes.title: Major Patch - Matchmaking Improvements and China Fixes
notes.notes:
We've improved [b]Matchmaking[/b] so you can now find matches throughout the whole world rather than just your local region. With 13 regions across the world that means you're now 13x times more likely to find a match! Our team is so excited to play with you all!

We've also fixed a Major issue for our [b]Chinese players[/b] where they were being placed in the Mainland China servers because their Operating System is Chinese even though they aren't located in Mainland China. You should now correctly connect to Mainland China if that's where you are located. If you're still not, see the next paragraph:

We've also given the player the option to switch their Server Region in the Settings menu. You can switch between Mainland China and All Other Regions. We HIGHLY recommend you leave this setting set to the default, but this setting will be helpful for players who want to play with friends in the other region.

These are the three major improvements, but the full patch notes are below.

Thank you so much for your patience. Hope you have fun!

SplitSide Games & Daedalic Entertainment

[b]Full Patch Notes [/b]
[i]Improvements[/i]
[olist]
[*]Players can now choose to connect to Mainland China or All Other Regions in the settings menu. This will be helpful for players trying to connect with friends into and out of China but it may produce connectivity issues.
[*]Matchmaking is greatly improved so that players can find matches in all the regions around the world and not just the region they are located in. Players connected to “All Other Regions” will not be connected to Chinese matches and players connected to “Mainland China” will not be connected to matches in other parts of the world.
[*]Matchmaking is limited to 3 races in a row so that players are reintroduced into the matchmaking pool to make matchmaking run more smoothly.
[*]Turkey and South Africa: Enabled dedicated servers in Turkey and South Africa. Now that these servers are enabled, players that live in these regions must update to this patch.
[/olist]

[i]Bug Fixes[/i]
[olist]
[*]Fixed bug where Chinese players were mistakenly being placed in Mainland China even though they are located outside of Mainland China.  
[*]Fixed bug where non-latin names incorrectly displayed on the Friend Invite, Matchmaking, and Leaderboard screens.
[*]Fixed bug that was introduced in the last patch where acorns in Windy Woods are glowing.
[*]Fixed a few issues where the UFO would take a team backwards in Wet Willy’s.
[/olist]

[i]Major Known Issues[/i]
[olist]
[*]Sometimes players may briefly disconnect from the servers and get a pop-up notification that they aren't connected to the internet. If this happens in matchmaking, you can restart matchmaking without any issues. We're working hard to find the cause of this issue.
[/olist]

notes.title: New Patch 0.8.18
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

thank you so much for playing Fling to the Finish! It has been amazing to see all of your feedback. Many records have been broken, many characters unlocked and of course many teammates flinged to reach the finish line.

We are aware that there are still some technical problems in the current Early Access version that prevented you from having the best time possible.

This first patch addresses a lot of these issues and ensures a better experience for everyone. But we don’t stop here. We are already hard at work on the next patch that will arrive early next week. For that, we want to make improvements to matchmaking and address the server issues some of you are experiencing.

Once all of these issues have been ironed out, we will add more content to the game. We will share more details on our first major update very soon. In the meantime, make sure to check our official Roadmap for more details:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34767207/e471ac36233f2080eb0c2b389520d466680bd664.png[/img]

Thank you for your patience and continuous support. We hope that you enjoy the game! Keep on flinging!

SplitSide Games & Daedalic Entertainment

[b]Full Patch Notes[/b]
[i]Improvements[/i]
[olist]
[*] Turkey and South Africa: Enabled dedicated servers in Turkey and South Africa.
[*] Character Select: only available characters will be shown (to the extent that it is possible). Locked characters will not be shown, and if possible, characters that have already been taken by other players will also not be shown, while cycling through characters to pick them.
[*] Character Select: Added two new skins that are unlocked by default to help give more options in lobbies that have unlocked any extra characters yet.
[*] Lobby screen: players now have to hit the “A” button on their controllers to join them in the lobby screen. This will help with bugs where some people are unable to control the game at all in the menus. It will also help make the lobby screen more consistent with how keyboards join.
[*] China: All “Discord” options will be removed if the player owns the Chinese version because Discord doesn’t work in China. Other social media icons are also disabled.
[*] If the player is trying to find players through matchmaking for a long time, they will be shown a message that there might not be enough players in their region at the moment.
[/olist]

[i]Bug Fixes[/i]
[olist]
[*] Localization: Invite friends screen: non-Latin text based player names would appear as squares.
[*] Localization: Leaderboards screen: - non-Latin text based player names would appear as squares.
[*] Gameplay: golf/square in the hole gates would get de-synced and not unlock for all players in online mode.
[*] Gameplay: The UFO ability now chooses the correct position to start moving down the racetrack. It will no longer take teams backwards.
[/olist]

[i]Bug Improvements[/i]
Respawning while stuck to physics objects would cause the objects to freak out in online mode. This should happen much less often now.

notes.title: Fling to the Finish's Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone, Fling to the Finish is out now on Early Access! [/h3]


We can’t wait for you all to fling your friends around. 


If you want to get more people playing the game and to have a good time, spread the word! Sharing the game with friends will help build our community and get more people flinging. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34767207/6715b5a24c49aac558dbdf1f99a2c2b066005049.gif[/img]


In Fling to the Finish teams of two players race through colorful, chaotic obstacle courses while tethered by a stretchy elastic rope. Depending on your communication skills, this rope can be your greatest asset or your worst enemy - just like the friend you’re tethered to. Because you're literally attached to your partner, Fling to the Finish is a truly cooperative experience. Masters of the rope use it to swing around perilous obstacles, and fling their partner up ledges seconds before they fall to their doom. And when you and your friend have earned the experience to call yourself a true veteran-duo, prepare for some astonishing acrobatic feats.


Your friendslist is empty or everyone on it is sleeping? No Problem! Check out our brand new Discord Community opened up for you to find players - or rivals!

[url=https://discord.gg/f4BzfF4eXC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34767207/f6c851b30e1f8bf43e5c2481e9bc968e2c9db103.png[/img][/url]


Early Access means to us that we plan to further improve the game experience by adding new content like new maps, game modes, characters and more over the course of the Early Access period, and also invest in polishing and balancing, using the feedback of you - our community.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34767207/e471ac36233f2080eb0c2b389520d466680bd664.png[/img]


Hope you all have a great time playing and let’s get the bright future of Fling to the Finish rolling!

SplitSide Games & Daedalic Entertainment
